task_input_descriptions.planner:
Task video description:
A close-up laparoscopic view shows a large, smooth, pinkish-red organ, likely a uterus, occupying the center and right of the frame. A metallic surgical instrument with a serrated tip enters from the top right, while a second instrument with a white, segmented shaft enters from the left, manipulating a pale, tubular structure, possibly a fallopian tube, attached to the organ. A yellowish, lobulated mass is visible in the lower left. The instruments gently retract and adjust the position of the organ and the attached tube, causing slight shifts in the tissue and the reflection of light on the organ's glossy surface. The background consists of out-of-focus, yellowish-brown tissue. The lighting is bright and direct, creating a strong specular highlight on the central organ.

A close-up laparoscopic view shows a large, smooth, pinkish-red organ, likely a uterus, occupying the center and right of the frame. A metallic surgical instrument with a serrated tip enters from the top right, while a second instrument with a white, segmented shaft enters from the left, manipulating a pale, tubular structure, possibly a fallopian tube, attached to the organ. A yellowish, lobulated mass is visible in the lower left. The instruments gently retract and adjust the position of the organ and the attached tube, causing slight shifts in the tissue and the reflection of light on the organ's glossy surface. The background consists of out-of-focus, yellowish-brown tissue. The lighting is bright and direct, creating a strong specular highlight on the central organ.
